translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Chuny dhano chano gik modwaro timo,
to dwoko margi aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Yore duto mag dhano nenorene ni longʼo,
to Jehova Nyasaye ema ongʼeyo mopondo mag chuny.
Ket gimoro amora mitimo e lwet Jehova Nyasaye,
to chenrogi biro dhi maber.
Gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye timo oseketo gikogi,
kendo giko mar joricho en tho.
Jehova Nyasaye odagi ji duto man-gi sunga e chunygi.
Ngʼe ma malongʼo: Ok ginitony ni kum.
Nikech hera kod adiera ema omiyo richo otimne misango,
kuom luoro Jehova Nyasaye miyo ngʼato kwedo richo.
Ka yore ngʼato moro Jehova Nyasaye,
to omiyo kata wasike dak kode gi kwe.
Ber bedo gi matin kod tim makare,
moloyo mangʼeny kod tim ma ok kare.
E chuny dhano ochano yore,
to Jehova Nyasaye ema telone ondamo mage.
Ruoth wuoyo kaka chik mar Nyasaye dwaro,
to dhoge ok onego ndhog bura makare.
Rapim mopogore opogore makare aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye,
to gik mipimogo manie mifuke gin meke moloso.
Ruodhi mon gi timbe maricho,
nikech kom mar loch obedo mana kuom tim makare.
Ruodhi ohero joma wacho adiera
kendo gigeno ngʼat mawacho adiera.
Mirimb ruoth en jaote mar tho,
to ngʼat mariek biro hoye.
Ka wangʼ ruoth nenore mamor to nitiere ngima,
ngʼwonone chalo gi rumbi mag koth e ndalo chwiri.
To ber maromo nade yudo rieko moloyo dhahabu,
yiero ngʼeyo tiend wach moloyo fedha!
Yor ngʼat moriere tir kwedore gi richo;
ngʼat manono yorene orito ngimane!
Sunga kelo masira,
chuny mar ngʼayi kelo chwanyruok.
Ber bedo gi chuny mobolore e dier jochan,
moloyo pogo gik moyaki gi josunga.
Ngʼato angʼata mawinjo puonj dhi maber,
to ojahawi ngʼatno moketo genone kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Ngʼat man-gi paro en ngʼat mariek,
kendo weche mowacho gin mana puonj.
Winjo wach en soko mar ngima ne jogo man kode,
to fuwo kelo kum ne joma ofuwo.
Ngʼat mariek rito weche mawuok e dhoge,
kendo wechene mowinjore kelo puonj makare.
Weche mag mor chalo gi mor kich
gimit ne chuny kendo gikelo ngima ni choke.
Nitie yo manenore ne dhano ni nikare,
to gikone otero mana ngʼato e tho.
Miluma ma jatich nigo miyo otiyo matek,
kendo kech makaye miyo omedo tiyo matek.
Ngʼat marach chano timo timbe maricho,
to wechene chalo mach mager.
Ngʼat ma timbene richo kelo mana miero,
to jakwoth pogo osiepe moherore.
Ngʼat ma ja-mahundu wuondo jabute
mi otere e yorno ma ok ber.
Tangʼ gi ngʼat ma buonjo kodi nikech onyalo bet ni ochano timoni marach,
ngʼatno maluwo dhoge ochomo timbe maricho.
Lwar en osimbo mar duongʼ
to iyude gi ngʼat man-gi ngima makare.
Ngʼat ma terore mos ber moloyo jalweny,
ngʼat makweyo mirimbe ber moloyo ngʼat mamonjo dala maduongʼ.
Igoyo ombulu mondo ongʼe gima ditim,
to kuom ngʼado weche duto Jehova Nyasaye ema tieko.
